claims.text: The platform's own telemetry establishes the deviation. Measured as POL-RD-01 requires, the gps_trace polyline runs 10.78 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events (EV-GPS-00106) against a booked optimal of 7.2 km (EV-TRIP-00106) — an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km. The governing figure is the trace figure, not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 10.8, and the finding is safe on the trace figure. The route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own evidence, not on the rider's characterisation of it.

The trace that carries the finding is clean, so no corroboration burden arises. EV-GPS-00106 holds 169 fixes at a 10-second sample interval with 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. None of POL-RD-07 limbs (a) to (c) is met — no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m, no sustained interval above 30 seconds. The trace is therefore unimpaired for policy purposes as well as clean in the admissibility pre-pass, POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged, and the excess needs no independent source to stand.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The artifacts describe the same trip: trip_id TRP-00106 appears on the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown, and the trip_record's started_at of 08:35:15 matches the first fix on the trace to the second. Excess above the POL-RD-01 threshold is shown on an unimpaired trace. The burden now shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to escape the excess; the bundle contains no counterparty_statement and no such citation.

No part of the excess is attributable to a rider instruction. The chat log for this trip holds exactly one message, from the RIDER at 08:46:30 — 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us' (EV-CHAT-00106). That is a complaint, not an instruction; waypoint_hint is null and no road or place is named, so the corroboration test in POL-RD-04 cannot be run and the clause exonerates nothing. The message does independently corroborate the rider: it was sent mid-trip, while the vehicle was still off-corridor, and the driver never answered it.

No traffic advisory is on file, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run in the driver's favour. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00106-01, is MISSING and carries weight_multiplier 0.0 — I disclose that impairment and its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT in this claim, as POL-GEN-02 requires. POL-RD-03 demands an advisory record naming a road the optimal route traverses, with a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle would have reached that segment; there is no such record, so no closure or queue can be matched, no exoneration reduces the excess, and no amended optimal is supplied.

The absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and it does not escalate this case. No party has asserted an external traffic cause or cited EV-ADVIS-00106-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — disclosed here under POL-GEN-02). Under POL-RD-13 limb (1) a missing artifact that no one has invoked is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5), so the escalation trigger does not fire; under limb (2), the rider having shown an excess over threshold on a trace that is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), the deviation stands at the measured 3.58 km and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route of 7.2 km and 19.0 minutes.

The POL-RD-02 arithmetic yields a refund of SGD 10.72. charged_total is 26.04. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 7.2 km + 0.28 x 19.0 min) x the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is 1.0, + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 of ERP on the optimal route, because the platform's own routing engine returned no gantry on that corridor (EV-TRIP-00106, optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00) = 15.32. Refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 gives 10.75. That is 41.2% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, and far above the 0.50 de minimis, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

The 5.50 of ERP the rider objects to is answered by that same refund, and must not be added on top of it. Both charged gantries — CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) at 3.00 and CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel, towards City) at 2.50 — carry on_optimal_route false against a route whose optimal ERP is 0.00, so the recomputed fare contains none of it and the whole 5.50 is already comprehended in the 10.72. Under POL-RD-09(1) it is itemised in the ruling for transparency but never stacked on the POL-RD-02 figure. I do not press POL-RD-09(4): the trace does pass both gantries (nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, well inside the 250 m match radius), so no charge here is phantom and the rider's relief comes through the recomputation, not a billing-integrity correction.

Honest concession on materiality: on the governing trace figure the excess is 49.72% of optimal and 3.58 km, so under POL-RD-01 this deviation is ESTABLISHED but falls just short of MATERIAL (which requires more than 50% or more than 8.0 km). The rider does not contend that it is material and rests no relief on the materiality limb; the entitlement to the 10.72 refund arises from establishment alone.

Honest concession on the driver's record: the POL-RD-06 pattern test is not met. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 96 — below the 3-flag trigger, and 0/96 is below the 0.05 ratio — so no repeated-deviation pattern is established, POL-RD-06(a) to (c) do not engage, and the rider does not seek the FULL_REFUND uplift or a conduct referral on this record. Under POL-GEN-01 the finding rests on this trip's trace alone; the profile is cited only because POL-RD-06 names these two fields.

Nothing here requires a human reviewer, and escalation would only hold the rider's money rather than return it. The trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, so POL-RD-10(2) does not fire; the trace is unimpaired, so (3) does not fire; the refund of 10.72 is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total, so (6) does not fire; and the three artifacts that carry every deciding fact — EV-TRIP-00106, EV-GPS-00106 and EV-FARE-00106 — each carry weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issues, so under POL-GEN-02 the confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is comfortably clear. The case should be ruled on the arithmetic now.

This dispute was filed by the RIDER and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the refund under POL-RD-02 is a refund to the filing party. Under POL-GEN-03 a PARTIAL_REFUND returns part of the contested 26.04 and leaves the rider no longer carrying the off-route distance and the 5.50 of ERP that the platform's own optimal route would never have incurred. The rider's opening ask of the full 26.04 is more than the policy's arithmetic provides, and the rider does not press for more than the policy gives: 10.75 is the amount that moves.

ruling.explanation:
This is a route-deviation dispute over a Toa Payoh to Bugis trip charged at SGD 26.04. Both sides agree on the material facts and on the arithmetic, and so does the tribunal. The ruling is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75 to the rider.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. Measured as the policy requires, the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00106) runs 10.78 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events, against a booked optimal distance of 7.2 km (EV-TRIP-00106). The excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. Both establishment tests under POL-RD-01 pass (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), so the deviation is established. The governing figure is the trace figure; the trip record's rounded 10.8 km copy may not be cited for the threshold test.

THE DEVIATION IS NOT MATERIAL. The materiality limb requires an excess greater than 50% of optimal or greater than 8.0 km. At 49.72% and 3.58 km, neither is met. The rider expressly does not contend otherwise, and the tribunal agrees. The consequences are that the POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern uplift, the FULL_REFUND limb and the driver-conduct referral are NOT engaged. On the driver's record the POL-RD-06 test fails in any event: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 96, below both the 3-flag trigger and the 0.05 ratio, so no pattern is established and no conduct referral issues.

NO EXONERATION APPLIES. The driver advances no excuse and none is available. The only traffic advisory in the bundle (EV-ADVIS-00106-01) is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00106) holds one rider message, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us', with waypoint_hint null and no instruction, so POL-RD-04 exonerates nothing. No amendment timestamps or amended optimal figures exist, so POL-RD-05 does not apply; the vehicle is a taxi and the fare is metered, so POL-RD-12 and POL-RD-11 do not apply. Because no party asserted an external traffic cause and no one cited the absent advisory, POL-RD-13 confirms the gap in the bundle is not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, and the case is ruled rather than escalated.

THE REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, fare model METERED). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 7.2 km + 0.28 x 19.0 min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 of ERP on the optimal route (the routing engine returned no gantry on that corridor) = (3.80 + 5.40 + 5.32) + 0.80 = 15.32. Refund = charged_total 26.04 - recomputed_fare 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 10.75. That is 41.17% of charged_total, below the 90% share that would convert the outcome to a FULL_REFUND, and above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor. amount_sgd = 10.75.

ERP IS NOT STACKED ON TOP. The SGD 5.50 of ERP (CTE Braddell Rd 3.00 and CTE Chin Swee Rd tunnel 2.50) sits on gantries the optimal route does not use. Both are matched to the vehicle's own trace (nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, inside the 250 m match radius), so neither is a phantom line and no separate billing-integrity refund arises under POL-RD-09(4). Because the refund is computed under POL-RD-02 against a recomputed fare that contains only on-optimal-route gantries, the whole 5.50 is already comprehended in the 10.75 and is itemised here for transparency only. It is never added on top.

CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (169 fixes, 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s), so no corroboration burden arises and POL-RD-10(3) does not bite. Trip identifiers and timestamps match across the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown; the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires and POL-GEN-03 confirms no escalation. The deciding facts rest on EV-TRIP-00106, EV-GPS-00106 and EV-FARE-00106, each carrying weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is clear.

WHAT MOVES: the rider receives SGD 10.75; the remainder of the SGD 26.04 charge stands. No driver compensation is payable. No referral is issued.
